import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    L = np.log(P)
    return (P*(params[0] + params[1]*t + params[2]*t**2)
            + P*L*(params[3] + params[4]*t**2)
            + P**2*(params[5] + params[6]*t + params[7]*t**2)
            + params[8]*P**2*L + params[9]*P**2*L*t)
